name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.4.4 (2026-05-23) is the largest release since v0.4.0 (169 commits), introducing Rooms (isolated workspaces), full internationalization across 40 locales with RTL support, an Integrations Hub for Slack/Discord/Google via MCP, and a mobile-responsive layout. v0.4.0 (2026-04-30, 433 commits) added a Skills system, multi-provider AI runtime (BYOAI with 8 CLI providers), terminal mode, and a Tasks Board v2. The project became MIT licensed as of v0.4.0. See release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2026, most recently v0.4.4 on 2026-05-23
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Not explicitly documented in changelog; onboarding captures name/email with consent, but no auth system is described

breaking_excerpts: Rooms migration: data/ is now a neutral 'home' container and each room is a top-level cabinet; the data root is no longer a working cabinet. Existing installs migrate automatically (data is backed up first).
Removed the status-bar page-scoped AI edit composer and the redundant task-page back buttons in favor of sidebar navigation.
cabinetai CLI refuses to bootstrap in $HOME or / and recommends ~/Documents/Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet but is significantly heavier to self-host and configure.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell provides robust document organization with AI-assisted tagging and multi-user support, but requires more infrastructure than Cabinet's minimal footprint.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy is a feature-rich document management system with workflows and permissions, making it more enterprise-oriented and complex compared to Cabinet's simplicity.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud Files
alternatives.review: Nextcloud Files covers document storage as part of a much broader platform, offering more integrations than Cabinet but with considerably more overhead and complexity.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focuses on browsing files across multiple backends, but lacks dedicated document management and tagging features found in Cabinet.
